organization: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative
title: USTR Takes Action in Forced Labor Section 301 Investigations
claim: Section 301 tariffs on 60 economies: 10% for economies with forced-labor import bans (e.g., Canada, Mexico, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Bangladesh, Cambodia, UK); 10% or 12.5% net of MFN for certain EU/Japan/Korea/Taiwan/Switzerland products; 12.5% for all other investigated economies. Effective 2026-07-24 per law-firm alerts as Section 122 tariffs expired.
